name: Blueberry Crumble Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Savor the comforting sweetness of Blueberry Crumble, an infused pre-roll that captures the essence of fresh, sun-ripened blueberries. Its aroma weaves together rich layers of blueberry, warm spice, and a touch of earthiness, creating a sensory experience that's as complex as it is soothing. This relaxing indica is your perfect companion for unwinding, offering a moment of tranquility wrapped in a flavor as delightful as its name.
